implementation_policy: libuipc CUDA IPC solve (pyuipc 0.0.29) of a fringed cotton scarf as a strain-limiting Baraff-Witkin thin shell with discrete-shell bending, frictional self-contact and quadratic air drag, coupled to a 6.7 kg wooden chair that is a free affine body on the floor; the scarf is built draped over the chair's top rail with both ends clear of the seat and released at t = 0 with no pinned vertex and no prescribed motion (physics/common.py layout and physics, physics/simulate.py). Every edit starts from frame 1 of the accepted source solve and changes only its DSL-resolved field (scarf Young's modulus with stretch, shear and bending scaled together, scarf density, scarf-chair friction), adds a free 0.65 kg book body over the seat, or leaves the chair body out (physics/edit_vocab.py). appearance/render_replay.py is the accepted renderer (room, chair model, scarf fabric and camera of the accepted delivery); appearance/realism.py, the current look, rebuilds the scene from each case's native cache: the scarf plays the native vertex states through a Mesh Cache of the exact solver positions, the chair and book follow the native transforms, and only the room, lights, materials, props and the fixed camera of appearance/view.py are its own. tools/export_ground_truth.py writes each case's ground truth from its native cache and that camera; --stage verify checks the accepted delivery, the native inputs and the published suite. Effective material parameters, not fitted to a measured scarf.
